column1: # - ref1..ref4 can be either an ABSOLUTE path (C:\refs\hero.png) or a BARE filename (hero.png).

Place the product on a marble kitchen counter at golden hour, natural daylight from a window on the left.

Outdoor lifestyle shot, hands holding the product, blurred forest background, bokeh.
